summary: The fourth argument and the enumerated-leaves credential model land correctly and completely across design.md, decisions.md, phases.md and history.md, matching the shipped chart template and entrypoint, with no supersession notices in the register. One blocking finding: a sentence this diff added to design.md declares the hook image free of estate facts and fully environment-driven, which the image P4 shipped contradicts — it bakes the tfmirror.home CLI config and the homelab root CA.

findings.summary: design.md:90-93 claims the image carries no estate facts and that everything a run needs arrives as env vars; the shipped image bakes image/terraform.rc (tfmirror.home) and homelab-root.crt.
phases.md A.2/A.4 owe and consume 'the inventory' but the argo-cd set cites no path to the credential-inventory attachment slice 009 must author the ExternalSecret from.
